answer: Each agent must earn a nontransferable reputation by completing tasks whose results are checked against later outcomes; identities that split or reset lose that accumulated record. For example, a wharf agent can build a thread of verified delivery commitments before its work counts toward a summit allocation. A Sybil operator must therefore fund and operate many agents long enough to establish separate histories, while passing the same outcome checks as everyone else. Cheap names alone buy no influence.
